01Welcome to Tower

Since 1902, Tower has been a second home for Princeton students. It is where we share our meals, look out for one another, and make friends we keep for the rest of our lives.

1902 Founded by four sophomores and Frank “Pop” Little ’03
1917 The year our clubhouse at 13 Prospect was completed
50+ Meal options every week, made to order
220 220 juniors and seniors call Tower home
